Page 245 Cont.
Nov. 14 Mrs. Grace Bidille - close to 70 - lutheran - Wife of Dr. Biddle in David Whitney Bl'dg.
Page 246 Nov. Mrs. Rose Mahon -66- fearful cancer - cancer removed this a.m. on table from 8 o'cl. till 12 .... so far hopeful Gowenlock 1 Howar Manear
Nov. 22 Harry Smythe - 38 - deaf with deaf wife and child - no employment Eliz. (Mrs.) Cottrell - 73 - bronchites - finds it hard to breathe ....
Mrs. Yolanda Murphy - 33 - carrying baby supposed to be dead now two months - Am advising her to ask for Nivification in honor of Ven. Sr. Mary of Jesus - writer of "City of God".
25 Eliz. Griffith - 26 - Good Folks - practical good girl but seems to have contracted drug habit.
Mrs. Marie Popelier - 57 - operation for cancer successful but burnt. Joseph Wm. Klein - 24 - nearly killed last Sunday A.M. by reckless driver - unconscious for quite some hours.
Michael Evola - 39 - Seemingly deranged - in Rec. Hospital.
Page 247
Nov. 26th Joseph Wolfstein - Elderly Jew - wife and
James Keyes of Woodstock, Ont. - 45 - Epileptic 18 yrs. started through fearful accident - a driller .... was going from Loraine Kuls 11 T.B. in Kiefer Anthony Dottenbock - old man - Valley Station, Ky.
27 1:20 P.M. Arthur Bringard - 16 - Lukemia - on way to Ann Arbor - very pale - weak - mother nevery pale weak - mother never baptized, con- sents that she believes in God .....
